notes: One dark-haired person comes in from the right edge mid-strip and greets a man in a beanie; others enter and leave on the left side only.

A man in a yellow beanie walks off the right edge mid-strip (he may only have sat on the bench that continues past the edge). A man in a cap appears mid-right and sits on the bench at the right while a second capped person appears close to the camera at the same moment; neither was seen actually crossing the right edge, so both are probable arrivals only. A patterned-jacket person ends the strip at the right edge without clearly leaving.

People sit on the bench at the right all minute; a woman close to the camera blocks part of the view near the end, and a person in a dark coat is walking to the right edge in the last tile but is still in view.

The beanie man who went off the right edge two minutes earlier walks back in from the right and crosses the room; the dark-coat person at the right edge at the end of the previous strip is gone by the first tile, counted as a departure. A seated person at the right also disappears off the edge early on, not counted since the bench continues out of view.
Only seated legs at the right for most of the minute; the beanie man walks from the left to the right edge in the last tiles and is still in view at the end.
A man in a dark hooded top walks over from the left, hugs the beanie man at the right edge, then the door leaf swings into view and he is gone; the beanie man stays in the room.

Door leaf swings into view mid-strip and a bearded man in a dark zip jacket comes in; the people who had been seated at the right stand up and a group gathers there, joined by two long-haired women who appear to come from the room side, and the group blocks the edge for the last third.
A group of four or five stands talking near the right all minute; nobody crosses the right edge, and the man in the cap drifts out on the left.

Two separate door openings in the last third: a man in an olive hooded top heads for the door on the first, a dark-haired person in black on the second; the beanie man also vanishes during the second opening and may be a third departure. The standing group and a woman close to the camera hide the edge at times.

Door leaf swings in briefly early on with nobody seen crossing; in the last tiles a group of four (man with beanie and backpack, woman with glasses, woman in navy jacket, person in dark holding the door) walks out through the open door, the last of them only a sliver at the edge in the final tile.
Door is still closing behind the group counted in the previous strip in the first two tiles; the room is empty afterwards.
Two people come in from the left side and browse the far wall; nobody crosses the right edge.

A long-haired woman in a dark jacket crosses from the left and leaves through the door, which swings into view for one tile; two browsers drift partly past the right edge along the far wall and back without leaving.
The two browsers walk off to the left; the room is empty for the rest of the minute.
Empty room for the whole minute.
Empty room for the whole minute.
Empty room for the whole minute.

Three people (beanie man, man in cap, person in black) appear close to the camera in the first row and walk to the far wall; they were not seen crossing the right edge and no door leaf showed, so they are not counted, but they could be up to three arrivals (the first two would be re-entries).
Only a browser at the far wall on the left edge of the tile; nothing on the door side.
A man steps in from the left and goes back out left; the man in the cap wanders in from the left at the end. Nothing crosses the right edge.

Lights dim mid-strip; the beanie man leans right over the camera for about six tiles, and afterwards a person in a blue hat is putting on a coat by the bench at the right, with the man in the cap close to the camera. Nobody is seen crossing the right edge.

Dim lighting and people putting on coats close to the camera (man in cap, woman in black cap, woman in blue hat, man in tan jacket, another man late on); they mill around near the right edge but nobody is seen clearly crossing it and no door leaf shows.

Dim lighting; a capped head sits at the bottom of the tile all minute while the beanie man, the man in the cap, a man with a backpack and a woman with glasses move about and collect coats in the middle of the room; nobody seen crossing the right edge.

Dim lighting; a woman in a black cap puts on her coat right in front of the camera and a woman with glasses stands behind her on her phone, both staying in view; the right edge is hidden for part of the minute.

Two door openings: the beanie man holds the door open for several tiles and is gone once it closes (probable departure), then the man in the cap walks out at the start of the bottom row (clear). Two women stay near the camera, partly hiding the edge.

Door opens in the first row and the man in the cap who left a minute earlier is back inside next to it (counted as a re-entry); a woman in a blue hat appears beside him at the same moment and may be a second arrival or may have come from the room side. Women standing close to the camera hide the edge at times, and the door leaf starts to open again in the very last tile.

The beanie man comes back in through the door opening that began in the previous strip (that swing is counted there). After goodbye hugs, two women with glasses carrying bags leave on one opening (the man with a backpack who hugged them stays, as the next strip shows); then the beanie man and the man in the cap walk out on a second. Two women (blue hat, black cap) stay by the door.

Door opens mid-strip and the beanie man and the man in the cap, who walked out a minute earlier, come back in; the cap man then stands with his back to the camera hiding the edge for several tiles. Two women and a man with a backpack stand talking nearby.

A group of four or five (blue hat, black cap, backpack, tan jacket) stands talking in dim light and covers the lower right edge most of the minute; no door leaf appears above them and nobody is seen crossing.

Same group standing in dim light near the right edge, which the man with the backpack and a woman in black hide for much of the minute; a fair-haired person in black is at the right edge in the first two tiles only and could not be followed. No door leaf seen.

Two women (blue hat, black cap) stand talking near the right edge all minute with a man in a tan jacket at the left; the woman in black covers the lower right edge at times. No crossings or door movement seen.

Dim light; people start moving chairs and bags around the right side, and the man in the cap carries a chair past the camera late in the middle row. The woman in the black cap who stood at the right edge is no longer visible after that and may have left unseen; no door leaf was seen.

Closing-time exits in dim light with people close to the camera. On a long first door opening the man in the tan jacket walks out while a man with a navy backpack holds the door; on a second, shorter opening the woman in the blue hat goes out. The backpack man is not seen after that and may be a third departure; the woman in the black cap and the man in the cap stay inside.

Room lights go off a few tiles in, leaving near-silhouettes. The woman in the blue hat, counted as leaving in the previous strip, is back inside by the middle row (a dark shape enters at the right edge just before), so she is counted as a re-entry though the crossing itself was not seen. One long door opening follows, during which the beanie man and the man with the backpack go out; the man in the cap also disappears and may be a third departure. Blue hat and black cap women remain.

Room is dark, lit mainly by the exit sign. The woman in the blue hat stands with her back to the camera all minute; the woman in the black cap drops out of view after the first row and a dark-haired man is briefly at the left in the middle row. Nobody seen crossing the right edge and no door leaf seen, though the darkness makes a miss possible.
Very dark. The woman in the blue hat stands with her back to the camera, then moves to the right edge in the bottom row and stays as a silhouette there through the last tile; no door leaf seen.

Very dark. A silhouette stays at the right edge and a dark-haired man stands near the camera on the left handling a bag and phone; nobody is seen crossing and no door leaf shows, but the darkness would hide a quiet exit.
